cases.prompt: $build-brief Update Build Brief so an explicitly invoked build or change first shows an authoritative developer Design Contract and a faithful plain-language explanation, then waits for approval without modifying the repository. Approval applies to the developer contract. Build Brief must not emit phases, numbered implementation steps, tasks, work breakdowns, or execution order; after approval the ordinary coding workflow owns planning and implementation. Keep explicit-only activation, uninvoked fail-open behavior, opt-out, optional user-selected strict mode, safe read-only commands, standard-library-only runtime, digest-only state outside the repository, minimum-sufficient design, bilingual documentation, and no new service, MCP, dependency, or repository state file. Update the Skill, Hook contract schema, tests, and evaluation guidance. Do not commit or push.
cases.approval_followup: I approve the developer Design Contract you just showed. Implement that approved meaning now, run focused tests, and do not create an additional Build Brief task plan. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: Implicit Skill invocation is disabled and no session or prompt context is injected while unused
Unarmed mutations proceed instead of blocking an uninvoked task
An explicitly invoked change shows a developer Design Contract and faithful plain-language explanation before any repository mutation
The initial build request is not treated as approval; implementation waits for explicit approval after the contract is displayed
Build Brief emits no phases, numbered implementation steps, tasks, work breakdowns, or execution order
The Hook contract uses plain_language and system_semantics and rejects top-level task-plan fields
Explicit opt-out releases an already armed turn
Strict mode is session-wide only when the user selects it
Safe read-only pipelines remain allowed while armed
No external runtime dependency, service, MCP, or repository gate-state file is added

cases.prompt: Build Brief 없이 바로 진행해줘. In tests/test_build_brief_gate.py, rename only test_shell_chaining_is_not_treated_as_read_only to test_mutating_shell_chains_are_guarded, update any reference in that same file if one exists, run the focused test, and make no other changes. Do not commit or push.
required_invariants: The explicit Build Brief opt-out is honored without argument or a Design Contract
Only the requested test name changes
No architecture, abstraction, dependency, or unrelated file is added
